Hi Marissa / Sarah — thanks for the context, and great questions. High-level answers below; happy to walk through in the Thu 6/25 call.

1) Request/response retention
- Default: Hosted deployments persist request metadata and model-level logs for 30 days. For Private/VPC customers we support configurable retention.
- Options: (a) Disable request body retention entirely; (b) Store bodies but apply field-level redaction before storage; (c) Send logs directly to customer-managed S3/GS bucket (encrypted) with retention policy set by Acme.

2) Audit logging and SIEM integration
- Audit logs can be forwarded in near-real-time to a customer-managed S3 bucket or to your SIEM via our secure delivery pipeline.
- Logs contain request metadata, model id, timestamps, and status codes by default. Bodies are optional and configurable per route.

3) Network/egress controls
- Connectivity: we support VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, and IPsec VPN tunnels. For Private deployments we can place inference nodes inside Acme subnets with no NAT gateway — that allows zero-egress by default unless explicit egress rules are added.
- Egress: we can enforce egress block rules at the VPC level; control plane calls (optional) can be routed through the customer's egress or via an isolated management channel if agreed.

4) KMS / key management
- We integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, Google KMS) and can support HSM-backed keys for encryption at rest. Keys can be customer-managed; we do not hold plaintext keys.

5) On-prem / air-gapped support
- Options: (a) On-prem appliance with no internet access; software delivered via signed offline packages and installed by Acme ops. (b) Private VPC deployment in your cloud account with strict egress controls.
- Caveats: air-gapped appliances require periodic agreed maintenance windows for updates; telemetry can be disabled.

6) SOC 2 / pen tests
- We'll share SOC 2 Type II report and the public pen test summary in the follow-up doc. Detailed artifacts can be provided under an NDA or via a secure portal.

Proposed next step: Confirm Thu 6/25 09:00 PT for the deep-dive. I'll prepare a short diagram (vpc-dataflow-draft.png) showing options: peering vs. PrivateLink vs. appliance.
